source.snippet: We are writing to notify you of a data security incident that we detected on October 30, 2026 and are continuing to investigate... Our investigation identified evidence the attack w[as successful]... It's not on their website or Trust center yet, but we received the following breach notification from WorkOS.

problem_statement: B2B SaaS companies that delegate auth/identity infrastructure to third-party providers (e.g., WorkOS) have no independent real-time monitoring layer to detect when their identity provider is breached; customers learn of incidents only via email, often days after the fact.
target_segment: Security engineers and CTOs at B2B SaaS companies that use third-party auth/SSO providers as critical infrastructure
notes: WorkOS breach (Oct 30, 2026) disclosed by email before appearing on their Trust Center — 69 points, 9 comments on HN indicates real concern. Pain: companies relying on auth providers for SSO/enterprise features had no independent signal their vendor was compromised. Opportunity: a continuous third-party identity-provider health and breach-signal monitoring service that alerts customers faster than vendor self-disclosure. Buyers are security teams already paying for vendor risk management tools.
